gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-m-plus-2: Comic Relief hits hard, with no visible difference between its upright and sideways strokes and bowls left open on one side. M PLUS 2 is the sans that holds it steady, drawn with one fixed nib width.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Approachable is odd for a heading this loud, but Comic Relief keeps its strokes uniform and leaves bowls unfinished on one side. M PLUS Code Latin bends neon-tube letters of constant thickness.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-manjari: Loud and lopsided: Comic Relief leaves bowls unfinished on one side and shows no difference between up and side strokes. Manjari, a sans-serif, keeps its unvarying line weight and wide terminals.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-metrophobic: Rope-like, all of it: Comic Relief gives every stem, bowl and tail one consistency, bowls unfinished on one side. And Metrophobic, the sans-serif body, lets the eye glide around every bend on a smooth, unobstructed path.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-mina: Mina draws plain strokes, like a stitched thread outline, and leaves each small round letter generously unclosed. Comic Relief, loud and uniform in stroke, makes that sans feel composed.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-moderustic: Modern in outlook, Comic Relief shows no weight shift along any curve and leaves its bowls unfinished on one side. Moderustic, a sans with broad-nib curves also left unfinished, shares the habit.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-nanum-gothic: Nanum Gothic reads with real generosity, thanks to wide channels leading into each counter. And beside Comic Relief's plain stripe of constant ink, paragraphs would settle into a steady, easygoing pace.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-niramit: Niramit reads with gaping letter curves, a sans that lets daylight into every shape. And Comic Relief, with no swelling where curves meet stems, gives it a sturdy, uniform headline above.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-canadia: Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal reads with openness at every curve end, a sans that never closes itself off. Comic Relief, wholly free of stroke modulation, sits beside it with no fuss.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-sans-cypro-m: Steel-cable strokes with no weight shift: Comic Relief leaves bowls unfinished on one side. Noto Sans Cypro Minoan, a sans-serif, cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap, loosening the loud heading.
